name: Dreamed Secrets (Mythic)
body:
Your mad dreams give you unparalleled magic power.

Prerequisite(s): Dreamed Secrets.

Benefit(s): You can select spells up to the level you can cast with Dreamed Secrets, and there is no risk of spell failure when you cast one of them. By expending one use of mythic power, you can instead cast the mythic version of a spell selected with Dreamed Secrets.
